snippet.title: ONTOS - Extended Gameplay First Look
snippet.description:
An extended look into Crombie’s experiment. 

In ONTOS, you play as Aditi as she navigates her way through a repurposed moon hotel in search of answers. Along the way you’ll encounter strange Experiments and uncover secrets of Hotel Samsara, as well as the people in it.  

In this video, we’ll take you deeper into one such Experiment led by Crombie, a scientist drawn to Samsara in search of answers about the essence of one’s unique, individual self. 

But by the end you must ask yourself, how will you proceed? 

Wishlist ONTOS: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924520/ONTOS/ 

Follow our socials: https://www.ontosgame.com/link-hub
